name: Orascom Investment Holding S.A.E.
source: stockanalysis.com (secondary data provider, figures as reported by that provider for the Egyptian Exchange listing)
note: Rebuilt 19 Oct 2026 from the provider page, which reports FY2025 and five annual periods. The previous file printed FY2024 revenue of EGP 357.4m, which matched neither the provider figure for FY2024 (EGP 481.3m) nor its own cost of sales, so that column was replaced. Figures in EGP, whole units. Net Profit is the group figure including discontinued operations where the provider reports them, which is why Profit Before Tax less Income Tax differs from it in FY2023, FY2022 and FY2021.

rows.label: Operating Expenses
rows.withhold_reason: withheld: Gross Profit - Operating Expenses does not equal the filed Operating Profit and the file carries no extra line that explains the gap, so the operating expenses (or operating profit) cannot be established from the statement; an honest blank beats a figure that fails its own arithmetic

derivation: Margins are computed from the stored rows. ROE, ROA and Debt to Equity are not stored because they need a balance sheet from the same source.
